lines.zh: 圆石缝里的青苔，被磨掉了。
lines.en: The moss between my stones has worn away.
Made of cobble, I fear the pick.

lines.zh: 丛林叫我，我就迈这一步。
lines.en: The jungle calls. I take the step.
Snow lands on my shoulder and melts.

lines.zh: 这具身体，走不远也要走。
lines.en: This body. It walks anyway.
Who's ahead? I'll look.
One step. One dead twig.

lines.zh: 铜锈在膝盖里叮当作响。
lines.en: Verdigris jingles inside my knees.

lines.zh: 我压过的草，过一会才抬头。
lines.en: The grass I flatten lifts its head later.
Iron legs are heavy. One step, one pit.
I'm not tired. Just heavy.

lines.zh: 你催你的，圆石按自己的节奏。
lines.en: Keep urging. Cobble keeps its own pace.

lines.zh: 我落脚，枯叶全都跳起来。
lines.en: I plant a foot. The dead leaves jump.
This body of cobble fears a pick above all.
The pumpkin on my chest went cold.

lines.zh: 站久了，青苔就当我是石头。
lines.en: Stand long enough and the moss thinks I am a rock.
Standing still counts as rest.

lines.zh: 石头不着急，锈也不着急。
lines.en: Stone takes its time. So does rust.
Clouds move faster than me.
Moss grew a little more.

lines.zh: 我等命令，等到苔藓爬上膝盖。
lines.en: I wait for orders until moss climbs my knees.

lines.zh: 胸口那点火，够我站到天黑。
lines.en: The fire in my chest lasts until dark.
Rust comes slower when still.
Bird claws slip on my shoulder.
Count to a thousand. Again.

lines.zh: 没有命令，我替丛林站岗。
lines.en: No orders, so I keep watch for the jungle.
I stand still, and even the wind goes around.
My whole body is cobblestone.

lines.zh: 你的脸，我刻进石头缝了。
lines.en: I carved your face into my seams.

lines.zh: 圆石拼的身子，缝里长着苔。
lines.en: Cobbled together, moss in my seams.

lines.zh: 圆石堆成的身子，守着这座村。
lines.en: A body of cobble, guarding this village.
Which cobblestone should I lift?

lines.zh: 八十点血，都是石头堆的。
lines.en: Eighty health, all piled stone.
If you speak, speak.
This cobblestone body fears a pick most.
The vines behind you are mine.
Looking up makes my neck creak.
Your hand shakes, the grip is loose.
You're back again.
Did you bring a pick? I can see it.
Only a pick can hurt me.

lines.zh: 这一块已经裂到心口了。
lines.en: This crack has reached my chest.
Was that a pick? Come out.
Slow but hard to fell.
That dented something.
Iron feels pain, you know.
Wind keeps pouring through the crack.

lines.zh: 我记下这一下了，圆石有裂纹。
lines.en: I registered that blow; my cobble cracked.

lines.zh: 圆石叠的身子，镐子最怕。
lines.en: A cobble body—picks are what I fear.
You dare hit me?
That iron... let me see it.
Give it. I'll work for you.

lines.zh: 你握得太紧，石头都裂了。
lines.en: You held too tight; the stone cracked.

lines.zh: 大圆石傀儡，镐头才敲得动。
lines.en: Only a pick cracks the big cobble golem.
That iron could patch my chest.
I see the glint of iron.
Gold's shine calls louder than food.

lines.zh: 南瓜塞进胸腔，刚好卡住。
lines.en: A pumpkin wedges right into my chest.
Copper. I can smell it.
Just looking. Not taking.
I'm heavy. Move aside.

lines.zh: 圆石碰圆石，火星都出来了。
lines.en: Cobble against cobble; sparks fly.

lines.zh: 撞掉我肩上的一片青苔。
lines.en: You knocked a patch of moss off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是一堵会走的墙。
lines.en: You walked into a wall that walks.

lines.zh: 八十点的身子，你也推得动？
lines.en: Eighty points of body. You think you can push it?
Your bones are harder than my cobbles.
Hitting me is bad luck.
Now I have a dent.

lines.zh: 赶时间也等我挪开这块。
lines.en: In a hurry? Wait till I move this shoulder.
Who hit whom? Unclear.
Don't worry. I won't rust fast.
Closer. Let me see your seams.
I give you half of me.

lines.zh: 你站左边，我站右边，守到老。
lines.en: You on the left, me on the right, until we rust.
Half my furnace fire is yours — don't refuse.

lines.zh: 我的接缝里，草都长出来了。
lines.en: Grass has grown in my seams.

lines.zh: 我这块头，比小傀儡沉一倍。
lines.en: Twice the bulk of the little golem.
Two cold hands warm up if held long enough.
Were you made too?
Your name, carved in my chest.
The jungle chest is safe with me.

lines.zh: 这包东西，我塞进石头缝里。
lines.en: This bundle goes into a crack in me.
My pockets grow heavy.
This. I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 这朵花，我别在青苔旁边。
lines.en: This flower goes beside my moss.
This stone looks like me.
Too clumsy. Almost crushed it.

lines.zh: 弯腰费劲，可我一件不落。
lines.en: Bending is hard work, but I drop nothing.
The gold nuggets on the ground are mine now.
The wooden box is light. I pinch it carefully.
Hide in the vines? They know me.

lines.zh: 八十点血的拳头，认准你了。
lines.en: A fist with eighty points behind it picks you.
I see your shadow.
Fine, then — begin.
Jungle cobble packs tight.

lines.zh: 你踩到的是我护着的边界。
lines.en: You stepped on the border I guard.
This fist was saved for you.

lines.zh: 我挪一步，你的退路少一条。
lines.en: One step of mine, one escape route gone.
Running won't help. I'll wait.
You. Come with me.
A pick can pry me apart; remember that.
One step of mine and the sand sinks.

lines.zh: 站住，我这一手能甩你出去。
lines.en: Stop. One swing of mine throws you.

lines.zh: 丛林里没人替你挡这一拳。
lines.en: No one in the jungle will block this fist for you.

lines.zh: 你跑不过我这身圆石的耐心。
lines.en: You cannot outlast this cobblestone patience.

lines.zh: 我这身圆石，扛得住镐子。
lines.en: This cobble body takes a pick or two.
I flatten the grass ahead.
Slow, yes, but these legs never stop.

lines.zh: 丛林尽头，藤蔓堵着，走不掉了。
lines.en: The jungle ends in vines. There is no way out.
You circle. I don't.

lines.zh: 你跑得再远，也还在丛林里。
lines.en: Run as far as you like. Still the jungle.
This part of the jungle, I know well.
One swing and you fly.
Stop. Let's talk.

lines.zh: 我一步顶你三步，数着呢。
lines.en: One of my steps is three of yours. I am counting.
One grab and a toss sends you flying.

lines.zh: 林子里的藤，会替我拦你。
lines.en: The vines in there will hold you for me.

lines.zh: 我一甩手，把目标扔出去。
lines.en: One swing and I throw my target away.

lines.zh: 我这一拳，能把人甩出去。
lines.en: One punch of mine throws a man.

lines.zh: 我这一掌，能把你甩进藤里。
lines.en: This palm throws you into the vines.
This ends here.

lines.zh: 我的名字刻在你身上了。
lines.en: My name is on you now.

lines.zh: 我抬得慢，落下来准得很。
lines.en: I raise slowly, and land precisely.
Cobble knuckles, aimed at you.
The jungle wants this cleared. Blame it.
For the village.
I hear you rattling.

lines.zh: 我一拳，能把你甩出丛林。
lines.en: One punch throws you out of the jungle.
Let's go again.
The cobble fist is coming down.
Dodging is pointless. I still catch you.

lines.zh: 丛林里我站着，像一堵墙。
lines.en: In the jungle I stand like a wall.
Stand first, let the moss learn me.
New stone, soil still packed in my seams.
Iron on my tongue, and rainwater too.

lines.zh: 石头里有什么动了一下。
lines.en: Something stirred inside the stone.
Feet sunk in mud. Now I am steady.
I have grown up out of the jungle.
In the jungle, moss covers all of me.
Pumpkin straight, iron true.

lines.zh: 苔藓下面，我在等着站起来。
lines.en: Under the moss, I wait to stand.
Who made me?
I don't know what to do.
First breath. No taste.

lines.zh: 丛林里，我的圆石还在滴水。
lines.en: In the jungle, my cobbles still drip.
My shadow is longer than the vines.
Fire doesn't hurt, but it reddens my copper.
My joints slipped out.

lines.zh: 水从缝里灌进来，太重了。
lines.en: Water pours into my seams. Too heavy.
A bang. I flew.
Hit from behind.

lines.zh: 圆石缝里那道冷光，又来了。
lines.en: That cold light in my seams again.
My furnace is fading.
Lightning is in my iron.

lines.zh: 别放手啊，大型圆石傀儡。
lines.en: Don't let go, Cobblestone Golem.
